issues.concern: The top-level gloss is incomplete as it doesn't cover all senses.
issues.suggestion: Add 'both...and', 'neither...nor', 'as many as', 'as much as' to the top-level gloss.

issues.concern: The gloss 'even' for sense 2 is incomplete and doesn't fully capture the nuance when used with negative indefinites.
issues.suggestion: Add 'any' (in negative contexts) to the gloss for sense 2, e.g., 'even, any'.

issues.concern: The English translation 'Nobody came.' is a natural rendering, but it doesn't explicitly show the 'even' or 'any' nuance of も in this negative indefinite context, which is what sense 2 is trying to convey.
issues.suggestion: Consider a translation that highlights the 'even' or 'any' aspect, e.g., 'Not even one person came.' or 'No one at all came.'

issues.concern: The English translation 'I haven't eaten anything.' is a natural rendering, but it doesn't explicitly show the 'even' or 'any' nuance of も in this negative indefinite context, which is what sense 2 is trying to convey.
issues.suggestion: Consider a translation that highlights the 'even' or 'any' aspect, e.g., 'I haven't eaten anything at all.' or 'I haven't eaten even a single thing.'

issues.concern: The English translation 'I don't want to go anywhere.' is a natural rendering, but it doesn't explicitly show the 'even' or 'any' nuance of も in this negative indefinite context, which is what sense 2 is trying to convey.
issues.suggestion: Consider a translation that highlights the 'even' or 'any' aspect, e.g., 'I don't want to go anywhere at all.' or 'I don't want to go even one place.'
